full_judgment: 5. Respondent No. 1 in his affidavit-in-opposition stated that the appellant was involved.in a number of Criminal cases and earned ill-reputation in the locality for his rude and rough behaviour. The Chairman of Fakirhat Union Parishads submitted a prayer to the Deputy Commissioner, Bagerhat (Respondent No. 2) for cancellation of license of the revolver of the appellant and confiscation of the same, It was, inter alia, alleged that the appellant, man of desperate temperament threatens to kill respectable men with his revolver with whom he differs. He threatened to kill Nawab Ali Fakir, Chairman. Fakirhat Union Parishad with his revolver inbroad daylight.
